devices.name: Flipper Zero
devices.description: Portable multi-tool for pentesters and geeks. Sub-GHz, NFC, RFID, IR, iButton, GPIO, BadUSB.

firmware.name: Official
firmware.notes: Official Flipper firmware. Update cadence has slowed — 1.5.1 was a bugfix to 1.4.2's IR CLI plugin. Still the latest tagged OFW release.

firmware.name: Unleashed
firmware.notes: Most stable community fork — API-compatible with OFW, adds region unlock and protocol expansions. unlshd-095 is a SubGHz hotfix for FAAC SLH decode.

firmware.name: Momentum
firmware.notes: Direct successor to Xtreme by the same dev team. Most feature-rich fork — 80+ apps, full JS SDK, custom asset packs. Flash via momentum-fw.dev Web Updater or Flipper Lab.

firmware.name: RogueMaster
firmware.notes: Bleeding-edge kitchen-sink fork that syncs both OFW and Unleashed. GitHub weekly builds; Patreon daily.

firmware.name: Xtreme
firmware.notes: Historical Xtreme firmware (XFW-0053). Upstream Flipper-XFW/Xtreme-Firmware repo is archived (verified 2026-11-18); kept for legacy reference only — not actively maintained.

firmware.name: FoxFW
firmware.notes: Active custom Flipper Zero firmware fork focused on Sub-GHz, NFC, automotive research, and ESP32 companion tooling. Use only on owned or authorized devices.

devices.name: HackRF One

firmware.name: Official HackRF

firmware.name: PortaPack Mayhem

firmware.name: PortaPack Havoc Modified
